# Public acceptance fixtures

`ocr-page.png` is a generated fictional page reading “ACTIVE RECALL” for English OCR checks.

`jfk.wav` is the short public JFK speech sample distributed in whisper.cpp `samples/jfk.wav`, retrieved from pinned commit `a8d002cfd879315632a579e73f0148d06959de36` (v1.7.6). It exercises real WAV transcription and Chromium fake-device recording. It contains no user recording or private data. Upstream: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/tree/a8d002cfd879315632a579e73f0148d06959de36/samples .
